name: Territorial Aetherkite
oracle_text:
Flying, haste
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters). Then you may pay one or more {E}. When you do, this creature deals that much damage to each other creature.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters). Then you may pay one or more {E}. When you do, this creature deals that much damage to each other creature.

needs.what: a `may` that lets the player announce how many {E} to pay, from 1 up to their current energy, charges exactly that much energy, and binds the count (e.g. `any_amount: {"as": "paid"}` accepted beside `pay: {"pay_energy": 1}`) so a following `reflexive_trigger` can deal `{"binding": "paid"}` damage to each other creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may.any_amount` is the right shape (it is exactly Leyline Tyrant's reflexive "when you do, deals that much damage"), but loader/effects._validate_pay_any_amount refuses any `pay` other than exactly one coloured or {C} mana symbol; Cost.pay_energy is a fixed int, so a fixed `pay_energy: 1` or `2` would drop the choice of amount. Flying, haste, the ETB trigger, `add_energy` 2 and `damage` to each other creature are otherwise expressible
